TRACKER_NOTES.Title: 218751-GMW Campaign Toolkit FVTT
TRACKER_NOTES.Settings.HPEffectsLocation: Choose where to display the actor's HP and active effects in combat chat cards.
TRACKER_NOTES.Settings.SkipTurnMarkersDe: If enabled, Turn Start/End chat cards will not be posted for combatants marked as defeated.
TRACKER_NOTES.Settings.SkipNoteCardsDefe: If enabled, the automated whisper containing actor notes will not be posted for combatants marked as defeated.
TRACKER_NOTES.Settings.HideTurnMarkersGM: If enabled, the public Start/End turn markers will not be displayed to the GM (they will still be shown to players if configured).
